Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Slave Quarters]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooineslavequarters.jpg tatooineslavequarters.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010829201506/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooineslavequarters.jpg Internet Archive], 29 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 539db0bd73b5caac97fdf099687107fa405a86209e764307a48aa2f6a16524ba.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 90 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (4 pixel rows of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.
